subject: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 repeater/comparator horizontal facing metadata and redstone port direction

observed_source_semantics.horizontal_index_order: EnumFacing.HORIZONTALS is populated in S-W-N-E horizontalIndex order; EnumFacing.getHorizontal(index) reads that array.
observed_source_semantics.repeater_metadata: BlockRedstoneRepeater.getStateFromMeta(meta) assigns FACING = EnumFacing.getHorizontal(meta); low two metadata bits therefore decode 0=south, 1=west, 2=north, 3=east.
observed_source_semantics.comparator_metadata: BlockRedstoneComparator.getStateFromMeta(meta) assigns FACING = EnumFacing.getHorizontal(meta); low two metadata bits therefore use the same S-W-N-E mapping.
observed_source_semantics.rear_input: BlockRedstoneDiode.calculateInputStrength reads the block at pos.offset(FACING), so FACING identifies the rear/input side.
observed_source_semantics.output_direction: BlockRedstoneDiode.getWeakPower emits only when state FACING equals the queried side; the causal front/output neighbor is opposite the stored FACING vector.

supported_relation.port_semantics: rear input is +FACING; front output is -FACING
